summary.text: Beast Calamity Immortal is the original owner of Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, a transformation path Gu Immortal who sacrificed his life killing an immemorial desolate beast and left myriad beings assimilation transformation as his legacy.

claims.text: Inside Star Snail Hall, a Combat Beast Guild master tells the assembled Combat Beast Warriors that history’s strongest among them sacrificed his life killing the star sea snail whose corpse now forms that hall. Bull-headed Demon God, Fang Yuan in disguise, strips three of Beast Calamity grotto-heaven’s locations of inheritances left untouched by the Combat Beast Warriors and identifies that same fallen warrior as the grotto-heaven’s original owner; those Warriors merge with beasts as a convenient but improper cultivation method, and even they remain unaware that its true owner, Beast Calamity Immortal, left behind a true inheritance of his own.

Beast Calamity Immortal had been heavily injured fighting the immemorial desolate beast star sea snail and suffered a fatal wound; on his deathbed he left behind his inheritances and forged the beast’s corpse into a final inheritance ground. A heavenly spirit in the form of a young qilin guards that ground and tells Fang Yuan that even though he has claimed several inheritances, he lacks full recognition: he may take Beast Calamity Immortal’s immortal killer moves but not his Immortal Gu or the grotto-heaven’s inheritance rights.
The heavenly spirit is born from Beast Calamity Immortal’s own obsession rather than being an ordinary land spirit.

Fang Yuan names Beast Calamity Immortal’s unique method the immortal killer move myriad beings assimilation transformation, built from four Immortal Gu. Its core is rank eight Adaptation Gu, Beast Calamity Immortal’s vital Gu, with the other three Immortal Gu in the move at rank seven. Beast Calamity Immortal used the move on the entire grotto-heaven rather than teaching it to individuals, so in extremity the grotto-heaven itself could merge with its Gu Immortals for temporary rank eight battle strength.

Beast Calamity Immortal died after suffering heavy injuries in his first myriad tribulation, and the grotto-heaven he left behind went on to pass many further calamities and tribulations without him, nearing its own second myriad tribulation by the time Fang Yuan annexes it.
